source_name: CERN Open Data CMS histogram demonstration
representation: Transcription of four authentic demonstration CSV lines from CERN's public histogram help page; original larger file not downloaded in this operation
time_granularity: 2010 only. Run and Event numbers are identifiers, not timestamps.
notes: Do not infer per-event timestamps from run ID or ingestion time.
H021 conceptual coil slots are ATLAS-specific, so CMS event fields do not uniquely occupy a 576-address position.
CERN page provided these rows as an example, and CERN cautions selection criteria differ from published scientific analyses.
